# Feinberg School of Medicine News Center

> Northwestern Medicine's authoritative source for medical research breakthroughs, clinical discoveries, and health science news from Feinberg School of Medicine.

The Feinberg School of Medicine News Center aggregates peer-reviewed research findings, clinical innovations, and faculty expertise across neurology, psychiatry, cardiology, and other medical specialties. The site serves journalists, healthcare professionals, students, and the public with curated medical news and multimedia content including podcasts and press coverage.

## Key Topics

- Northwestern Medicine
- Feinberg School of Medicine

- Clinical Breakthroughs

## Featured Research & News

- [Recent News](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/recent-news): Recent medical news, research and clinical breakthroughs from Feinberg
- [Editor's Picks](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/editors-picks): Curated selection of featured medical research and clinical expertise stories
- [Schizophrenia Study Finds New Biomarker, Drug Candidate to Treat Cognitive Symptoms](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2026/03/19/schizophrenia-study-finds-new-biomarker-drug-candidate-to-treat-cognitive-symptoms): Schizophrenia biomarker discovery and drug candidate for cognitive treatment
- [Premature Menopause Raises Long-Term Heart Risk by 40 Percent](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2026/03/18/premature-menopause-raises-long-term-heart-risk-by-40-percent): Study links premature menopause to increased coronary heart disease risk
- [Advancing Epilepsy Research Through Genetic Insights](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2026/03/16/advancing-epilepsy-research-through-genetic-insights): Epilepsy research advances through genetic insights and ion channel studies
- [FDA-Approved Compound Promotes Neuroprotective Effects in Parkinson's Disease](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2026/03/16/fda-approved-compound-promotes-neuroprotective-effects-in-parkinsons-disease): FDA-approved compound shows neuroprotective effects in Parkinson's disease
- [Calcium Signaling Channels Regulate Neuroinflammation and Motivation](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/2026/03/12/calcium-signaling-channels-regulate-neuroinflammation-and-motivation): Calcium signaling research reveals neuroinflammation and depression treatment insights

## News Discovery & Archives

- [Main Home](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu): Feinberg School of Medicine news hub featuring medical research and clinical breakthroughs

- [News Archives](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/news-archives): Browsable archive of past news with date and tag filtering
- [COVID-19 Coverage](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/pick/covid-19): COVID-19 research, vaccination studies and pandemic response coverage
- [Media Coverage Archive](https://news.feinberg.northwestern.edu/media-coverage): Archive of media coverage and press mentions from major outlets
